CHOCO_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for choco: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

CHOCO_VERSION.description: Specific version of choco to install.

CHOCO_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading choco binary or archive artifacts.

CHOCO_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying choco available remote releases.

CHOCO_SOURCE.description: Local directory or NuGet/Chocolatey feed URL used as the package source when installing Chocolatey packages (including offline caches).
